programme.desc: (1996) Brian Levant's festive all-action comedy. Arnold Schwarzenegger is on a mission to get his son (Jake Lloyd) the must-have Christmas toy, Turbo Man. But it's sold out everywhere...

programme.title: Tooth Fairy
programme.desc: (2010) Family fantasy comedy. Dwayne Johnson stars as a tough ice hockey player who is transformed into a real-life fairy as punishment for telling a child that tooth fairies don't exist.

programme.desc: (2006) Comedy-drama starring Anne Hathaway and Meryl Streep. A naive young woman lands a job as assistant to one of New York's most important, but ruthless and cynical, magazine editors.

programme.title: Mr Popper's Penguins
programme.desc: (2011) Family comedy. Jim Carrey stars as a work-obsessed New York property developer whose life is turned upside down when he receives a crate containing six live penguins.

programme.title: Deck the Halls
programme.desc: (2006) Comedy. Neighbours Matthew Broderick and Danny DeVito get extremely competitive as they festoon their houses with increasingly outrageous festive decorations and lights.

programme.desc: Try Something Different. Nigel Slater shows how incredibly versatile the ingredients in our fridge can be. He whips up a tasty duck and citrus salad and a chocolate beetroot cake. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Dish Of The Day
programme.desc: When Nothing Else Will Do. Nigel Slater delivers the ultimate line-up of indulgent treats. These include a slow roast leg of lamb and a truly decadent tumbler trifle. S1, Ep8

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: Dave and Si are starting off in Scotland. It was on these roads that they first became best friends, and now they're returning to the Isle of Bute. S1, Ep1

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: The duo are back in Scotland, in beautiful Dumfries and Galloway. It's a place close to their hearts, a rural paradise with a glorious coastline. S1, Ep2

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: The lads explore Dave's home county of Lancashire. They tour a crisp-making potato farm and create a dish celebrating the local spuds. S1, Ep3

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: For their next adventure in the west of Britain, Dave and Si explore Merseyside, an area renowned for its musical heritage and cultural identity. S1, Ep4

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: The Bikers continue their journey in northwest Wales, discovering a host of inspiring local producers celebrating the area's rich diversity. S1, Ep5

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: The duo's journey brings Dave and Si to the 220-mile-long River Severn, an area rich in natural beauty and famous for its fusion of flavours. S1, Ep6

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go West
programme.desc: Si and Dave travel down the west coast of the UK on a nostalgic and emotional journey, celebrating a passion for quality food, flavours and produce. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Yorkshire Pudding. Adam ticks 'Yorkshire Pudding in Yorkshire' off his foodie bucket list. Then, he tries Yorkshire parkin, local rabbit, and a Yorkshire tea-inspired dessert. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Sandwich. Adam heads to Kent to try a very special sandwich in Sandwich. There, he also tries Whitstable oysters, traditional fish and chips, and a new baked sensation, the cruffin. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Aberdeen Angus. In Aberdeen, Adam tries Aberdeen Angus at one of the city's finest steak restaurants. Later, he checks out meat pies from an award-winning local butcher. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Bakewell Pudding. In the Peak District, Adam learns more about the accidental invention of Bakewell pudding. Then, he visits a gastropub for his first taste of local grouse. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Eton Mess. Adam samples the famous Eton Mess in Eton. He also enjoys afternoon tea fit for a Royal in Windsor, samples venison in bon-bon bar snacks and makes some tasty fudge. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Glamorgan Sausage. In Wales, Adam tries Glamorgan sausage in Glamorgan. He enjoys Welsh rarebit and wonderful Welsh cakes, and bites into his Polish heritage with pierogis. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Lancashire Hot Pot. Adam has a hearty hot pot in Lancashire. He also tries a Brazilian sausage roll, world-famous black pudding and kicking Korean chicken-topped waffle. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Cheddar. Adam tries cheddar in Cheddar! He continues his rural discoveries with a cheesy celeriac bake with leeks that he harvests himself and farm-fresh chocolate milk. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Melton Mowbray Pork Pie. Adam enjoys pork pie in Melton Mowbray before sampling boiled sweets, a chicken curry in Leicester and a mac and cheese doughnut from a village restaurant. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Adam Richman Eats Britain
programme.desc: Tattie Scone. Adam tries a tattie Scone in Scone, plus a full Scottish breakfast. He also tastes haggis, neeps and tatties, sausage casserole and sweet shortbread. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: French Flavor And Meaty Kabobs. Guy Fieri dives into French fare and mouthwatering meat, including killer crepes in Colorado, elevated eats in Texas and kicked-up kabobs in Arizona. S39, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: From The Seas And Overseas. Guy Fieri reels perfect pierogies in Westminster, Colorado, killer Caribbean in San Antonio, Texas, and Southern seafood in Brunswick, Georgia. S39, Ep3

programme.title: The Vengeance of She

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1958. Print of Death. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring John Warwick, Tim Turner and Phil Brown. A payroll van is pulled over by a police car, the guards shot and the payroll stolen. (S1, E27)

programme.title: Signs of the Times: Peculiar Posts
programme.desc: 1946. An intriguing short film about the strange and unusual objects that have been sent by post.

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. Client: Jessup. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: BFI: A Message From Mars
programme.desc: 1913. Sci-Fi. Director: J. Wallett Waller. The first silent British sci-fi feature (with new score). A Martian visits earth to cure a selfish man (similar to 'A Christmas Carol') on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: The Larkins
programme.desc: Christmas with the Larkins. 1958. Stars David Kossoff, Peggy Mount & Ruth Trouncer. Ada invites a miserable man to spend Christmas with the family and Alf tries to defrost a meagre frozen turkey.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Christmas Goose. 1957. Stars Richard Greene, Jack Watling & Jane Asher. When a boy's pet goose is sentenced to be cooked for Christmas dinner, Robin and Friar Tuck join forces to save it.

programme.title: What the Dickens? It's Christmas!
programme.desc: Christmas is a time for reflection. Charles Dickens might've had more influence on Christmas celebrations than anybody in history, well, except one! Join Mike & Noel for a Merry Dickens Christmas!

programme.title: Christmas in the Street
programme.desc: 1968. Stars Arthur Leslie & Doris Speed. In this Coronation Street special, Jack and Annie Walker reminisce as they prepare for festivities in The Rovers Return, with flashbacks to bygone years.

programme.title: David Nixon's Christmas Magic
programme.desc: 1974. The magician and entertainer David Nixon is joined by some wonderful guests like Lynsey de Paul and Robert Harbin for a festive celebration of magic, comedy and music!

programme.title: The Stories Behind the Songs
programme.desc: Kate Garner plays a selection of festive songs and tells the stories behind them, including the tale of how mice chewing the bellows of a church organ led to the Christmas classic 'Silent Night'.

programme.title: For the Love of Ada: Christmas Special With Ada
programme.desc: Starring Irene Handl, Wilfred Pickles & Barbara Mitchell. A Christmas special of the gentle 70s sitcom about Ada and Walter, who find love.

programme.title: The Christmas Tree
programme.desc: 1966. Family. Starring Brian Blessed, William Burleigh, Anthony Honour & Kate Nicholls. Gary determines to get a tree for children who will be in hospital for Christmas. Directed by Jim Clark.

programme.title: The Long Arm
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Directed by Charles Frend. Stars Jack Hawkins, John Stratton, Dorothy Alison & Michael Brooke. The sleuths of Scotland Yard try to solve a series of burglaries.

programme.title: Scrooge: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Brian Desmond Hurst. Stars Alastair Sim, Jack Warner, Kathleen Harrison & Sir Michael Hordern. Christmas is not a time of celebration for the tight-fisted Ebenezer Scrooge.

programme.title: Pink String and Sealing Wax
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Googie Withers, Mervyn Johns & Gordon Jackson. Victorian Brighton; the tale of a pious chemists' household & the underworld occupied by landlady Pearl.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Holiday for Heatherton. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Diana Decker & John Stuart. Mark Saber is after an insurance agent who is planning to murder a girl who has an expensive taste for his modest wage.

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: To Catch a Thief. 1983. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Jennifer Lonsdale. The TV set breaks down and a man arrives. Ida assumes he is a repair man, but she soon realises he is not!

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 16. 1975. The Karl Denver Trio play 'Wimoweh' and The Platters perform 'Only You' and 'Smoke Gets in Your Eyes', plus George Roper, Ronnie Dukes and Ricki Lee star.

programme.title: The Odessa File
programme.desc: 1974. Thriller. Directed by Ronald Neame. Stars Jon Voight, Maximillian Schell & Maria Schell. A reporter tries to track down a number of SS officers who mysteriously vanished after the war.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by: Mark Robson. Stars: Kirk Douglas, Marilyn Maxwell & Arthur Kennedy. The struggles of a boxer fighting his own demons while trying to achieve success.

programme.title: SOS Pacific
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Directed by Guy Green. Starring Richard Attenborough, Pier Angeli & John Gregson. A flying boat fire forces its passengers, including a prisoner, to make a disastrous water landing.

programme.title: The Big Combo
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Director: Joseph H. Lewis. Stars Cornel Wilde & Jean Wallace. A police lieutenant, on a mission to bring down an elusive crime boss, targets the gangster's girlfriend to get her help.

programme.title: Law Of The Plainsman
programme.desc: 1960. Calculated Risk. Stars Michael Ansara, Don Grady & Gina Gillespie. While chasing after two bank robbers, Sam kills one in self-defence. The robber's son then threatens to kill Sam.

programme.title: The Great Rupert
programme.desc: 1950. Family Comedy. Directed by Irving Pichel. Stars Jimmy Durante, Terry Moore & Tom Drake. A little dancing squirrel with lots of charm helps two families overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: The Gentleman Bandit
programme.desc: 1981. Crime drama directed by Jonathan Kaplan. Based on the real-life ordeal of Baltimore priest Bernard Pagano who was arrested for a series of hold-ups.

programme.title: Tomorrow at Ten

programme.title: The Stories Behind the Songs

programme.title: The Runaway Bus

programme.title: Hobson's Choice

programme.title: Look At Life A Year for a Day

programme.title: Christmas 1946 (ABC)

programme.title: Z-Cars
